arabic text: TAFSEER BERIDA HAI NEZE PE HAI QURAN\nEK MALKA E GHAYRAT HAI EK DEEN KA SULTAN
english translation text: The interpretation stands unveiled, while the Qur'an is upon the spear;\none is the queen of honour, and one is the sovereign of the faith.

arabic text:
ALHAMD NOHA KHWAN TATHEER MATMI
WAN NAAS BHI HAI ZAKHMI WAL FAJR RO RAHI
AAYAAT KE GALE ME
BAANDHI HAI RASIYAAN
english translation text:
Al-Hamd recites lament, purification performs matam;
Surah al-Nas is wounded, and al-Fajr is weeping.
Ropes have been tied
around the necks of the verses.

arabic text:
KHIZRA SHAREEK E GHAM HAI SIDRA UDAAS HAI
GHAM ME NAJAF HAI DOOBA MADINA UDAAS HAI
GHAR SE KHUDA KE HAYE
UTHNE LAGA DHUWAN
english translation text:
Khizr shares the grief, and Sidra is sorrowful;
Najaf is submerged in grief, and Madina is desolate.
Alas, smoke begins to rise
from the house of God.

arabic text: HAR EK QADAM QAYAMAT YE SHAAM KA SAFAR\nZAINAB KA SAR KHULA HAI, NEZE PE SHEH KA SAR\nAABID KI AANKH SE HAI KHOONE JIGAR RAWAN
english translation text: Every step is Judgement Day upon this journey to Shaam;\nZainab's head is uncovered, and the King's head rests upon a spear.\nBlood from Abid's heart flows through his eyes.

arabic text:
NEZE PA KHOON KE AANSU ROTE HAI SHAAHE DEEN
BEHNON KE SAR KHULE HAI SAR PAR RIDA NAHIN
LARZAN ZAMEEN HAI GHAM SE
ROTA HAI AASMAAN
english translation text:
Upon the spear, the King of the faith weeps tears of blood;
his sisters' heads are uncovered and have no veils.
The earth trembles with grief,
and the heavens weep.

arabic text:
AALE NABI PE UMMAT DHAATI HAI YEH SITAM
SHOLON PE CHAL RAHE HAIN SHABBIR KE HARAM
TAREEKH ME HUWA HAI
AISA SITAM KAHAAN
english translation text:
The nation inflicts this oppression upon the Prophet's family;
Shabbir's sacred ladies walk through flames.
Where in history
has such cruelty ever occurred?

arabic text:
HAIN BAAQIR O SAKINA THAAME HUWE JIGAR
LAGTE HAI TAZIYANE ROTE HAI YEH AGAR
SAADAAT KA HUWA HAI
KAISA YEH IMTEHAN
english translation text:
Baqir and Sakina clutch their hearts;
if they weep, lashes strike them.
What kind of trial
has befallen the Sayyids?

arabic text:
MATAM KUNA MALAIK CHALTE HAIN SAATH SAATH
SAB AMBIYA BHI GIRYA KARTE HAIN SAATH SAATH
IS GHAM ME DO JAHAAN HAI
SALMAN NOHA KHWAAN
english translation text:
The mourning angels walk beside them,
and every prophet weeps beside them.
In this grief, both worlds
recite lament, O Salman.
